git_rationale.root_cause_commit: 00d602340cfff5601d3505780e625b666afa8d4b - cleanup: Delete backup files, archive directory

git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: Restoring the classification rules file allows agents to correctly classify POIs upstream, eliminating the need for hardcoded dedup in the generator. Removing the dedup block ensures the generator faithfully renders all data.
